create_visualizer_opengl: create a Visualizer instance with opengl renderer type for screenless 3D human mesh rendering
create_visualizer_gui: create a Visualizer instance with opengl_gui renderer type for interactive GUI-based 3D visualization
visualize_smpl_reconstruction: visualize SMPL reconstruction output with hand bboxes, body bboxes, body pose, and predicted mesh list
render_pred_verts_screenless: render predicted mesh vertices in screenless OpenGL mode with camera and optional side view output
visualize_smpl_pose_basic: visualize SMPL vertices from pose parameters using angle axis or rotation matrix format in GUI mode
